newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvia bourse turnover down, Unibanka gains.
newsitem.headline: Latvia bourse turnover down, Unibanka gains.

text.p: Turnover on the Latvian stock exchange slumped on Wednesday although market blue chip Unibanka closed slightly higher, dealers said.
Turnover was 136,000 lats versus 244,000 lats and Rietumu Bank's Rietumu 16 index rose 1.43 percent to 224.17 and Saules Bank's Saule10 index was 1.94 percent higher at 192.91.
Unibanka was up to 4.65 lats from 4.51 lats after it earlier announced that its 1996 profit doubled to 5.978 lats. It turned over 26,000 lats of shares.
Other official list stock Staburadze also gained, moving up to 2.90 lats from 2.85 lats on low trade of 6,700 lats.
The most active stock was Daugavpils Chain on turnover of 35,200 lats and it crept up one santime to 2.81 lats.
Valmiera Glassfibre, which has been volatile since it joined the bourse last week, slipped back to 2.28 lats from 2.31 lats on high turnover of 19,600 lats.

The rest of the market was fairly quiet. Fish cannery Salacgriva rose to 5.15 lats from 5.10 lats and traded 9,200 lats while official list stock Riga Transport Fleet traded 7,400 lats and was unchanged at 1.70 lats.
